notes: **Statement 007-N1.** The page cancels an unrestricted first trial of AtM4 and replaces it with a live clause beginning “Si X≪Y”. Its least-element phrase is struck and replaced by élément followed by an uncertain adjective. Part b imposes equality on two compatible internal refinements. The next two displayed axioms are numbered AtM6 and AtM5 and joined by an exchange connector; those written numbers are kept (Grothendieck, 1986, scan 7).

**Statement 007-N2 — later comparison with S SA21-K7-01.** The live X≪Y premise is direct textual support for a refinement-based intended formulation. It does not alter the closed triangular sign on scan006. The present clause is phrased at the level of strata, has different target wording and includes compatible uniqueness in b, so it is not a unique proof of S’s exact replacement X≪F. No additional proof of S’s earlier redundancy claim was performed on this page; the earlier checks remain those recorded under 006-N2.

**Statement 007-N3 — cancelled draft, targeted counterexample.** For nonempty M the cancelled first universal assertion need not hold. Take M={a}, equality as both order and refinement, and the closed family {∅,{a}}. With Phi=∅, the selected Phi^a is empty and has no least element. R2 supplied this counterexample; M rechecked it. It concerns the abandoned unrestricted draft only. The author’s subsequent restricted version is described in 007-N1/N2 and is not thereby proved.

**Statement 007-N4 — targeted nonemptiness check.** For X,Y in M, the live hypothesis X≪Y puts Y itself in {Z∈Y-tilde : X≪Z}, because Y≤Y. M and R2 checked this implication. Nonemptiness alone does not prove that the set has a minimal or least member, and this argument is not used to select the uncertain adjective in the insertion.

**Statement 007-N5.** For figures of finite type, the text says that the family datum may be replaced by compatibility together with the referenced closed-set and hereditary conditions. It displays the finite-type family as closed finite-type pairwise-compatible subsets. The general case additionally asks for a choice of certain infinite antifilters. Finally it describes an interpretation using Mulomb and Omb inside Fig(M), with references to GF pp.28 and32. These reconstruction and representation statements are background here, without independent proof; the referenced sheets were not consulted.

**Reading decisions and retained irregularities.** The range connector is a literal semicolon, against both witnesses’ à and R3’s colon. The lower primed premise in the slanted note is left Y′|X′ from its forked outline. The old small definition label is placed above its equivalence and retained as dfn|defn, not expanded to défini. The lower-case x in Omb(x) and M subscript ≪x is kept beside uppercase bound X. Mulomb has no t; its second argument remains F despite R1’s alphabet question. The lower où is live: its diagonal is the grave accent. Structure en plus is read literally.

**Layout and remaining limits.** The curved guide places Phi de t.f. above de M,≤ and does not introduce parentheses around the order pair. The implication’s curved lead-in and its overlap with the descending f are reproduced as one visible contour, not a second relation. The heavily crossed starts of AtM4, its replacement adjective, the old axiom numerals and the faint final specieux|spacieux remain the least secure parts of this page. “Dans le cas général” and “Pour avoir … il faut cependant un choix de structure en plus” state the author’s scope qualifications; no separate request to verify a proof or new date/title occurs. The written manuscript page number is6.

**Statement 007-N6 — conditional lemma checked by R1 and rechecked by M.** Assume the inserted adjective in AtM4(a) means minimal, use its live circled-refinement definition and clause b, and let A⊂M be downward closed and pairwise compatible. If A_X={Y∈A : X≪Y} is nonempty, choose Y0 in it and a minimal Z0 in its selected lower fibre. Downward closure puts Z0 in A; minimality also makes X circle-refine Z0. For any other Y in A_X, a similarly obtained minimal Z≤Y belongs to A and is compatible with Z0. Clause b gives Z=Z0, hence Z0≤Y for every Y in A_X. Thus A_X has a least member under these explicit assumptions. This conditional argument neither settles the uncertain adjective nor identifies an unwritten complete correction to scan006. The full independent proof is retained in R1’s report.
